note: Production sources for the Raps-reference baseline use Tillvaxtverket's published SCB 2024 demographic scenario where available. Latest SCB forecasts are retained only as alternative-scenario sources.

population_pre2025.purpose: historical population by region, marital status, age and sex

mean_population_pre2025.purpose: historical exposure population by birth-year age and sex

migration_pre2025.purpose: historical migration by region, age and sex

migration_2025.purpose: migration by region, age and sex, CKM

births_pre2025.purpose: births by region, mother's age and child's sex

deaths_pre2025.purpose: deaths by region, birth-year age and sex

migration_birth_region_pre2025.purpose: migration profile by birth region, region, age and sex

migration_birth_region_2025.purpose: migration profile by birth region, CKM

fertility_forecast.purpose: Latest SCB forecast alternative scenario; not the default Raps SCB-2024 reference

mortality_forecast.purpose: Latest SCB forecast alternative scenario; not the default Raps SCB-2024 reference

regional_forecast_benchmark.purpose: SCB regional population benchmark; not an input to the rAps-like base model

regional_flows_benchmark.purpose: SCB regional births, deaths and migration benchmark

national_forecast_detail.purpose: national forecast deaths, immigration, emigration and mean population by birth region, sex and age

national_forecast_births.purpose: national forecast births by mother's birth region and age

raps_fertility_forecast.purpose: Raps reference scenario SCB 2024: national age-specific fertility by mother's birth region

raps_mortality_forecast.purpose: Raps reference scenario SCB 2024: national mortality by birth region, sex and age

raps_national_detail_2024.purpose: SCB 2024 national forecast detailed deaths and mean population by birth region, sex and age; used to derive aggregate future mortality

raps_births_2024.purpose: SCB 2024 national forecast births by mother's birth region and age; used with projected female mean population to derive aggregate fertility

backtest_national_detail_2021.purpose: Vintage-correct SCB 2021 detailed national forecast for the 2022-2024 backtest

backtest_births_2021.purpose: Vintage-correct SCB 2021 births forecast for the 2022-2024 backtest

commuting_flows.purpose: employed persons age 15-74 by municipality of residence, municipality of workplace and sex; commuting/job-residence matrix

employment_age_profile.purpose: employed persons by workplace municipality, sex and broad age group; used as job-holder age/sex prior for workplace scenarios
